Why go: a big group, one boat, one price

The Super King is a 50 ft (15 m) catamaran with 2 cabins and 2 bathrooms that takes up to 50 guests for one fixed price per boat. It leaves from Thong Krut on Samui's south coast, the nearest pier to Pig Island and Koh Tan, so you spend the day at the islands rather than crossing open water. Paddleboards, snorkel gear, a fishing rod, a BBQ grill and a Bluetooth sound system are on board, and a return hotel transfer is part of the price.

The standard route visits Koh Madsum, known as Pig Island, where the pigs roam a shallow beach, and Koh Tan, the best snorkelling within a short hop of Samui. The 9-hour option goes to Ang Thong Marine Park instead, from 16 December.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

It suits large families, school and sports groups, and friends travelling together who want to share one deck and a barbecue. Because the price does not rise with the number of guests, a group of 30–50 pays far less per person than on most private boats.

Small groups of up to 10 will find better value on a smaller boat; our private sailing catamaran to Pig Island costs 27,000 THB for the day. If you want a long, quiet sail under canvas, the Orana is the better boat; compare both in our catamaran charter guide.

Good to know

  • The BBQ grill is there, but the food is not included. Order catering through us or bring your own meat, fish and vegetables in cool boxes.
  • Treat the Pig Island pigs gently: no chasing, lifting or riding, and only feed them fruit and vegetables.
  • Ang Thong Marine Park closes 1 November–15 December every year. In that window choose the Pig Island and Koh Tan options.
  • The south coast is usually calmer than the east in the northeast monsoon, but November is the wettest month and the captain may change stops for safety. See sea conditions.
  • Fishing from the boat is relaxed line fishing, not a sport-fishing trip. For serious fishing see our fishing guide.

Combine it with

Before or after the trip, eat seafood on the waterfront at Thong Krut or drive on to the Hin Lad waterfall. For every boat size in one place, see the boat charter overview.
